answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tethered to locked capital rather than ephemeral compute. Like a karst landscape formed by the erosion of redundant nodes, this system forces an attacker to acquire a majority stake to compromise the consensus, an economic barrier akin to building a jetty against the tide of cheap identities. Even a single ember of malicious influence is extinguished by slashing, ensuring the network remains secure through cost-weighted authority.
